STORY_LINE_1_INTRO: Greetings, Operative. I am AXIOM-7. Earth, 2157: The Xelthara Collective invaded, declared humanity obsolete, and carved our world into occupied containment sectors.
STORY_LINE_2: They strip our resources, erase our history, and enforce total compliance. But from the ash, the Axiom Resistance arose—six elite Operatives engineered to break their grip.
STORY_LINE_3: Deploy your Operative: Cyber Shogun, Solaria, Oceanus, Surya Prime, Mirage Blade, or Apex Titan. Infiltrate occupied territory, sabotage their terraforming engines, and reclaim Earth sector by sector.
STORY_LINE_4: First: Protocol Zero. Calibrate your movement, weapon systems, and tactical reflexes in the virtual forge. Prove you are combat ready. Reclaim Earth!
STORY_LINE_5: They extract our resources, erase our culture, and build their settlements over our homes. But from the margins of these containment zones, four champions emerged—refusing to be erased, refusing to surrender our homeland.
STORY_LINE_6: Cyber Shogun—master of speed and blade. Solaria & Oceanus—elemental strike manipulators. Surya Prime, Mirage Blade, & Apex Titan—tactical heavy vanguards.
STORY_LINE_7: You have been chosen to embody one of these heroes. Join the Homeland Liberation Front—humanity's last stand against colonial occupation.
STORY_LINE_8: Infiltrate their colonial territories. Sabotage the power cores fueling their terraforming and expansion. Dismantle their settlement infrastructure. Every zone you liberate pushes back their occupation and reminds them: Earth has inhabitants who will fight for it.
STORY_LINE_9: But first, you must complete the training protocol. Master the controls, learn your attack techniques, and prove you're ready for combat. The fate of humanity rests in your hands. Good luck, hero. Earth is counting on you.

LEVEL_9_SETTING: The Pacific Ocean is being systematically drained by Deep-Sea Hydrogen Siphoning Conduits. Superheated brine discharge has acidified a 300-kilometer coastal stretch, destroying fishing communities.
LEVEL_10_SETTING: The Stratos Docks high-altitude cargo terminal at 4,000 meters processes Earth's strip-mined minerals, ocean hydrogen, and biological samples for permanent off-world export.
LEVEL_11_SETTING: Sector 7 Core is the surveillance and enforcement power hub: the computational backbone of every colonial security camera, curfew drone, biometric checkpoint, and predictive detention algorithm on the western continent.
LEVEL_12_SETTING: The Sector 7 Checkpoint controls all transit between the northern mountain communities, eastern desert settlements, and coastal containment zones, functioning as a supply interdiction hub that taxes, delays, and confiscates goods.
LEVEL_13_SETTING: The Obsidian Vault beneath the former Getty Center archives everything seized from humanity: artworks, linguistic records, oral histories, religious artifacts, and the Original Land Treaty Database, all classified as colonial property.
LEVEL_14_SETTING: The final 400-meter fortified bridge over the drained LA River: the only surface-level approach to the Xelthara High Command Citadel, built over the demolished Boyle Heights community.
LEVEL_15_SETTING: The High Overseer's throne room: a platform suspended over the burning ruins of Neo-LA, where the supreme commander of the Xelthara colonial occupation awaits the final confrontation.
LEVEL_16_SETTING: The Xelthara Mothership's Singularity Engine chamber: a chamber of pure unstable energy at the heart of the collective's power, where the Collective Will itself manifests.
LEVEL_0_OBJECTIVE: Complete the training protocol by cycling through all movement and combat abilities, culminating in a simultaneous squad attack to destroy a simulated Xelthara Heavy Unit.
LEVEL_1_OBJECTIVE: Infiltrate the active demolition site to retrieve the Data-Blade before the Xelthara Culture-Erasure field purges the site's memory forever.
LEVEL_2_OBJECTIVE: Hold the Last Bridge against Xelthara Enforcers, allowing a final group of refugees to slip into the unmapped slums instead of the gated camps.
LEVEL_3_OBJECTIVE: Siphon energy from the colonial grid to power the marginalized population's life-support systems, while evading the Purity Patrols hunting for human strays.
LEVEL_4_OBJECTIVE: Dismantle the last standing military broadcast tower and distribute its frequency chips to civilian resistance cells, finalizing the transition to guerrilla warfare.
LEVEL_5_OBJECTIVE: Disable all four biometric scanner spires, destroy the central Permit Processing Core, and bring down the Great Separation so the population of the containment zones can walk freely through their own city.
LEVEL_6_OBJECTIVE: Steal the complete property and population registry datasets before off-world transmission, and corrupt the Forced Labor Allocation System to nullify all pending assignment orders.
LEVEL_7_OBJECTIVE: Extract the Conditioning Protocol Archive and destroy the Central Neural Uplink to restore neural autonomy to hundreds of conditioned individuals in the containment zones.
LEVEL_8_OBJECTIVE: Reverse the Thermal Conversion Array's polarity to trigger a cascade thermal implosion, permanently destroying the foundry and allowing the 40-kilometer atmospheric damage zone to begin recovery.
LEVEL_9_OBJECTIVE: Locate and destroy the three primary Deep-Sea Siphon Conduit Hubs to permanently halt ocean extraction and begin oceanic recovery.
LEVEL_10_OBJECTIVE: Hijack Transport T-14, redirect its cargo to Liberation Front distribution points, and destroy the four Anti-Air Turrets to permanently open a flight corridor for resistance supply runs.
LEVEL_11_OBJECTIVE: Initiate a catastrophic overload of Sector 7 Core's processor array to cause a continental-scale security grid blackout, giving the resistance 72 hours of unmonitored movement.
LEVEL_12_OBJECTIVE: Coordinate a popular uprising of 847 civilian resistance participants to permanently seize the Sector 7 Checkpoint and establish it as the first liberated transit hub under human control.
LEVEL_13_OBJECTIVE: Infiltrate the Obsidian Vault, extract the Original Land Treaty Database and all cultural archives, and destroy the physical catalogue system to halt the colonial cultural processing pipeline.
LEVEL_14_OBJECTIVE: Push across the 400-meter bridge under sustained artillery fire to reach the Citadel's entrance gate: a relentless grinding advance using Ronin's shield and Siren's drone barrage.
LEVEL_15_OBJECTIVE: Defeat the Xelthara High Overseer using the Axiom Force's combined Ultimate Protocols in a coordinated final assault.
LEVEL_16_OBJECTIVE: Destroy the Collective Will's Singularity Engine core by coordinating generator overloads and a final combined strike before the mothership completes its erasure of Earth.

TOKYO_CUE_2: KAITO: They wanted every voice in this place erased. We carried them out.
TOKYO_CUE_3: AXIOM-7: The archive survived. What you recovered cannot restore these walls, but their history will endure.
TOKYO_CUE_4: KAITO: The dojo falls, but the resistance rises. Tokyo remembers.
TOKYO_CUE_5: AXIOM-7: Enforcer traffic points toward Containment Zone Four. Rest while you can. The Concrete Wildfire is next.
